sectors.note:
**TL;DR:** Defensive and value-oriented sectors are showing solid underlying breadth, but fragile internal momentum in Healthcare and Financials suggests this defensive rotation may be unstable.

Defensive and rate-sensitive groups are quietly dominating trend breadth, with Healthcare, Real Estate, Financials, and Consumer Defensive all achieving "all-green" status across all timeframes. Industrials remains the absolute momentum leader (0.73), gaining one spot to secure the top rank, while Healthcare and Consumer Defensive also ticked up in the rankings. 

Conversely, Utilities and Energy are fading, leading the week's losers by dropping two spots and one spot respectively. Cyclical sectors continue to lag, with Consumer Cyclical anchored at the bottom of the momentum rankings (0.27) and Communication Services failing to make any upward progress.

## Strength
* **Broad-Based Defensives:** Four out of 11 sectors are "all-green" across weekly, monthly, quarterly, half-year, and YTD frames: Healthcare (0.68 momentum), Real Estate (0.58), Financials (0.53), and Consumer Defensive (0.45).
* **Industrials Dominance:** Industrials holds the highest overall momentum score at 0.73 and sits at rank 1.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Top Gainers:** Industrials (rank 1), Healthcare (rank 7), and Consumer Defensive (rank 6) each climbed 1 spot over the last five sessions.
* **Top Losers:** Utilities fell 2 spots to rank 8 (0.30 momentum), while Energy slipped 1 spot to rank 2 (0.45 momentum).
* **Entrenched Laggards:** Consumer Cyclical (0.27 momentum, rank 11) and Communication Services (0.40 momentum, rank 10) remain stuck at the bottom of the grid with zero rank improvement.

## Divergences
* **Fragile All-Green Signals:** Despite their perfect "all-green" status across timeframes, Financials (agreement: 0.30) and Healthcare (agreement: 0.48) exhibit low internal agreement, signaling that their current strength is highly unstable and prone to reversal.

industries.note:
**TL;DR:** Healthcare defensive sectors are dominating market leadership, while cyclical commodities and retail experience sharp near-term pullbacks.

Market breadth remains moderately healthy with 36 of 144 industry groups maintaining all-green positive trends across all timeframes. Healthcare is the clear driver of this strength, led by REIT - Healthcare Facilities and Biotechnology, which are both capturing top-tier momentum. Food Distribution and Semiconductor Equipment & Materials also show sustained multi-month leadership, anchoring the market's upper echelon.

Conversely, rotation is punishing commodity-linked and alternative energy sectors. Aluminum, Solar, and Uranium have tumbled sharply down the rankings over the last five sessions. We are also seeing early-stage rotation into beaten-down tech and consumer services, while several previously strong groups like Airlines and Diversified Banks are beginning to lose their rank momentum.

## Strength
* **Healthcare Dominance:** REIT - Healthcare Facilities (momentum 0.84) and Biotechnology (momentum 0.84) lead the 36 all-green groups, alongside Healthcare Plans (momentum 0.83).
* **Sustained Leadership:** REIT - Healthcare Facilities, Healthcare Plans, Food Distribution, Semiconductor Equipment & Materials, and Textile Manufacturing have successfully maintained their top-36 status across 1-, 3-, and 6-month horizons.
* **Broad-Based Anchors:** Financial Conglomerates (momentum 0.80) and Insurance - Property & Casualty (momentum 0.71) remain firmly in all-green territory, signaling steady financial sector support.

## Movers & Momentum
* **Rapid Climbers:** Consumer Electronics surged +33 spots to rank 56 (momentum 0.70), while Publishing and Staffing & Employment Services both climbed +27 spots.
* **Sharp Declines:** Aluminum dropped -28 spots to rank 69 (momentum 0.34), followed closely by Department Stores (-25 spots to rank 107) and Solar (-24 spots to rank 101).
* **Momentum Extremes:** Semiconductor Equipment & Materials holds strong as a top momentum leader (0.802), while Utilities - Independent Power Producers languishes as the primary laggard with a momentum score of just 0.086.

## Divergences
* **Fading Strength:** Airlines (momentum 0.75) and Banks - Diversified (momentum 0.69) are showing early signs of exhaustion, slipping 4 spots each over the last 5 sessions despite high absolute momentum.
* **Emerging from the Bottom:** Education & Training Services (rank +13, momentum 0.46) and Electronic Gaming & Multimedia (rank +10, momentum 0.46) are jumping in rank despite their currently low momentum profiles.
* **Fragile All-Green Trends:** Medical Care Facilities (agreement 0.45) and Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (agreement 0.49) exhibit low trend agreement, making their all-green status highly vulnerable to a reversal.

pulse.headline: Consumer Electronics leads gainers while weak breadth and fading momentum pressure markets.

This vulnerability is most pronounced in Medical Care Facilities (agreement 0.45) and Home Improvement Retail (agreement 0.46), followed closely by Oil & Gas Refining & Marketing (agreement 0.49) and Health Information Services (agreement 0.49).
